name: Kujou Tamaki
source: Head of the Kujou family and mother of the four sisters. She invites Taro into the mansion and seems to have some kind of relation with the time loop. To her, everything that happens in the mansion is a game.
translation: Head of the Kujou family and mother of the four sisters. She invites Taro into the mansion and seems to have some kind of relation with the time loop. To her, everything that happens in the mansion is a game.
